notes.title: DEMO Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[h1]Hi, Atoners[/h1]

We've just fixed some in-game issues:

[list]
[*] Most inlaid runes can produce stronger effects based on triggering conditions
[*] Balanced adjustment
[*] Item drop adjustment
[*] Fix some configuration issues
[*] Fix issues in the placement and synthetic materials of the home system
[/list]

If you have any questions, please leave us a message below, or join our discord!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/XYVeKzZemM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866716/66d4f214f8ae9353991bb46e4ba6858840401c53.png[/img][/url]

Wish you good luck in the journey of redemption!

notes.title: DEMO Hotfix #1
